summary: The PR addresses the issue by checking the builder name and the configuration option before generating viewcode pages for EPUB. The added test script ensures the fix works as expected.

issues.description: The PR includes a large number of generated files in the test directory, which are not necessary for the test to run and can clutter the repository.
The test script uses a procedural style instead of a testing framework like pytest, which is more common in the Sphinx project.
